phase: Phase 5: canonical/current Aquarium materials, following Alex's authorization to finish material response and handoff

material_response.normal_convention: OpenGL; derivative frames share the albedo mapping on terrain, facades, caps and curved routes
material_response.packed_channels: R roughness, G exposed-metal mask, B unused; metallic response capped at 0.25 for readable gold under the approved lighting
material_response.height_usage: Source references only; no runtime height, parallax or displacement
material_response.albedo: All nine active albedos remain byte-identical to their approved source PNGs
material_response.controls: Visual Lab F8: Material detail and Normal strength. Bound-material API: aquarium_selected_materials.gd.set_detail(root, enabled, strength).

approved_border_revision.selection: A: red with sparse gold studs
approved_border_revision.mapping: Retains the existing four-physics-pixel border width; horizontal repeat uses width * .01 * 4 / .48 to preserve the source image's 4:1 aspect and round studs.
approved_border_revision.verification: Historical Phase 3 captures used production Retro and default atmosphere. Every view's pixel evidence matched 2A-red-gold-studs, with zero fallback builds. Response maps were off at that stage; final_review supersedes these images.

requested_camera_review.verification: Four graphical Prototype captures from fresh disk bakes; seven selected material matches in the main Act and nine in RampMania, no fallback geometry builds. Production Retro, default atmosphere, HUD hidden. Temporary capture camera changes only.
requested_camera_review.border: These historical captures retain the previous 2A gold-scroll trim. Alex subsequently approved A, red with sparse gold studs.

floor_revision.status: Approved with brown timber connector removed; supersedes the all-blue floor proposal.
floor_revision.layout: Six by six square modules; broad stone center, blue edge panels and one blue cross-row. No timber connector. This is a composition study, not automatic routing along arbitrary Act edges.
floor_revision.mapping: Equal 3.6-unit X/Z world repeats preserve square blue panels; screenshot perspective is not baked into the mapping.

source: selected.gdshader; analytic source rebuilt and rendered directly, not enlarged Phase-1 images

albedos.1-mixed-floor: Approved floor revision; 512x512, equal physical repeat axes, irregular stone and square red-framed blue insets, no brown connector. Earlier 1-from-5A study is superseded.
albedos.2A-red-gold-studs: 512x128, repeat along length only; three sparse gold studs on red. Approved border revision A replaces the original gold-scroll 2A; source is border_revision/border.gdshader.
albedos.3B: 512x256, two complete timber panel modules; repeat along length.
albedos.4B: 512x128, six slate ceramic endcaps; repeat along length. Remains slate as explicitly approved, beneath red roofs.
albedos.5A-red: 512x512, six tile columns and four courses; repeat both axes.
albedos.6A-red: 512x128, same six-column tile rhythm as 5A-red, one course and gold edge; repeat along length.
albedos.7B: 512x512, three paving columns and four courses with red side rails; repeat along ramp length, width fitted to deck.
albedos.8A: 512x128, four gold clasps; repeat along length.
albedos.9A: 512x256, two complete three-by-four lattice modules; repeat along facade length. Do not slice windows at mapped module boundaries.

13B.kind: Material palette, not a painted branch texture
13B.preview: coral_preview.gd calls existing aquarium_park_decor.gd coral() with local material copies, unshaded albedo view; no gameplay or geometry changes
13B.integration_constraint: Apply only to coral/planting instances; the production coral material is also used by fish tails, so do not globally recolor that shared material.

review_limits: Historical texture sheets assess albedo only. Current final_review captures assess the real Prototype with structural response. Normals affect lighting, not silhouette; no geometry, gameplay or collision changes. No full regression suite or performance benchmark.
